informal_statement:
For every real \(\lambda>1\),
\[
\gamma_\lambda>0.
\]
For every real \(h\) with \(0<h\leq1\), there is a real \(r\) such that
\[
\begin{aligned}
0&<r<h,\\
A_\lambda(E_r)&=A_\lambda(C_h),\\
P_\lambda(C_h)-P_\lambda(E_r)&>\frac{\gamma_\lambda}{h}>0.
\end{aligned}
\]
Here area is Lebesgue weighted area and perimeter is Euclidean complete-frontier weighted perimeter.
